alice (runtime): FYI CI flagged a perf regression on int8 after merge #3942 — ~12% increase in 95th for redwood-7b-int8. failing job: https://ci.redwood/12345 :eyes:
release-bot: PR #3942 merged by @dmitri (kernel scheduler: favor coalesced batch kernels)
ben (ml-opt): ugh. can you paste a quick perf profile or p99 numbers?
alice (runtime): p99 jumped from 110ms -> 125ms on canary. quick pprof from the failing run:
```
kernel_selector.cpp:selectKernel 40%
kv_cache.cpp:lookup 22%
dequant.cpp:apply 18%
CUDA memcpy 12%
other 8%
```
carol (infra): canary rollout is flagged by SLOer, holding further canaries. please open rollout hold if not already. :no_entry:
dmitri (eng): assigning to bisect; what's the git range?
alice (runtime): range looks like origin/main~10..origin/main, suspect the scheduler heuristic change.
perf-bot: bisect started (builds/benchmarks scheduled).
ben (ml-opt): the scheduler scoring change favored kernels that batch-coalesce better; that can increase KV cache pressure if it packs more sequences into single execution, causing more KV misses and memcpy churn.
dmitri (eng): local microbench: reproduces on t4-gpu, time breakdown matches Alice's pprof. will run git bisect.
perf-bot: bisect complete — culprit commit 7d3b8f (change: prefer_coalesced_kernels=true by default)
ben (ml-opt): yep. the change didn't account for avg_kv_hits. simple fix: score += coalesce_bonus - kv_miss_penalty * (1 - avg_kv_hit_rate)
carol (infra): can we revert the merge while we patch? staging is seeing tail thrash.
dmitri (eng): created revert PR #3978 and started a staging rollback deploy.
alice (runtime): thanks — holding canary and rolling back staging now. i'll open an issue to add a hotness-aware term to the kernel scorer and add a regression test in the perf suite.
ben (ml-opt): also add a microbenchmark that exercises kv-cache hit/miss corner cases (small sequence with lots of prefixes) so this doesn't slip.
perf-bot: perf regression tracked as PERF-5632; alerting triage.
carol (infra): once revert is in, canary replay and verify p99 back to baseline before unholding.
dmitri (eng): ack — monitoring charts look better after revert started.
alice (runtime): follow-ups: PR for scorer patch, unit test, perf-suite case. will post links when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
